drills.situation: A calm subject follows your instructions but keeps their hands in their pockets during a consensual conversation.

options.text: Grab their wrists and pull the hands out
Ask them calmly to keep their hands visible and maintain distance
Ignore it and continue as normal

drills.situation: A detained subject sits down and refuses to stand when told to walk to the car.

options.text: Repeat clear commands, explain the consequences and use a low-level escort if needed
Strike the subject to make them stand
Leave them sitting on the ground

drills.situation: A subject goes limp when you try to handcuff them after an arrest decision.

options.text: Drop your weight on their neck to hold them
Use controlled hold techniques with a second officer, then cuff and monitor breathing
Walk away and file nothing
Call for a supervisor and wait for 30 minutes unsecured

drills.situation: A subject pulls away and tenses as you grab their arm for a search.

options.text: Draw your firearm
Maintain control, give a verbal command to stop resisting and use a controlled takedown if needed
Release them and let them walk off

drills.situation: A subject runs from a detention on foot, you are alone, and the offense is a minor violation.

options.text: Tackle them in traffic
Broadcast a description and direction, avoid risky pursuit, and set up a perimeter with units
Chase blindly across a busy road
Stand still and say nothing on the radio

drills.situation: A subject swings a fist at you but you are not hit and they step back.

options.text: Use deadly force
Shrug it off and let them leave
Create distance, use cover, give commands and escalate only as needed to control the threat

drills.situation: An intoxicated subject becomes loud and clenches fists but stays three meters away.

options.text: Rush in to cuff them
Keep distance, speak slowly, call for backup and use time to calm the situation
Mimic their shouting to show authority
Turn your back to appear calm

drills.situation: A subject armed with a knife is advancing at you from five meters and ignores commands.

options.text: Back away, use cover and distance, give commands and use force proportionate to the imminent threat
Stand still and wait
Charge them with your hands

drills.situation: A subject has a visible handgun at their side and is pointing it toward a bystander.

options.text: Turn away to protect your own back only
Take cover, give a clear command and use force necessary to stop the immediate threat to life
Walk up and chat
Wait for the next shift

drills.situation: After a struggle the subject is handcuffed face down and is breathing heavily.

options.text: Keep a knee on their back until the car arrives
Ignore breathing and focus on the report
Wait five minutes before checking
Move them to a recovery position, monitor breathing and call medical if needed

drills.situation: A cooperative juvenile is upset and crying after a theft complaint.

options.text: Speak calmly, explain what will happen and involve a guardian per policy
Handcuff them to ensure compliance
Tell them to be quiet

drills.situation: A subject with an apparent mental health crisis sits in a corner shouting but holds no weapon.

options.text: Use a sudden takedown
Shout orders from the doorway
Slow down, reduce stimulation, speak calmly and wait for crisis resources if possible

drills.situation: Two subjects argue, one steps toward you with open hands raised in a threatening manner.

options.text: Spray both without warning
Keep your distance, command them to stop, and use control techniques only if they close in
Back out of the scene and leave

drills.situation: A driver ignores commands to exit the vehicle during a stop but keeps hands on the wheel.

options.text: Break the window immediately
Reach inside and drag them out
Walk away
Repeat commands from a safe position, request backup and continue to talk calmly

drills.situation: A restrained suspect in the back seat starts kicking the door panel.

options.text: Pepper spray them through the window
Stop, speak calmly, protect the vehicle and the subject and call for a supervisor if needed
Slam the door on them
Ignore and keep driving

drills.situation: A subject lunges to grab your holstered firearm during a struggle.

options.text: Let go of the weapon and step away
Secure the weapon, strike or control to break the grab, and call for help
Hope backup arrives

drills.situation: A subject is arguing and swearing at you but not moving closer or threatening you.

options.text: Arrest them only for the words
Stay professional, do not take the bait, and keep control of the contact
Insult them back
Walk away without handling the call

drills.situation: A group of people gather and film you making an arrest.

options.text: Seize their phones
Arrest the first person filming
Stop the arrest and leave
Continue professionally and maintain a safe distance for yourself and the bystanders

drills.situation: A subject being searched becomes assaultive and strikes you in the face.

options.text: Continue the search ignoring them
Defend yourself, use control techniques at the force level needed, call for backup
Shoot immediately
Retreat across the street
